title: Ro Ro Kehti Thi Bano-e Dukhiya
body:
Ro ro kehti thi bano-e dukhiya
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
Tera laasha hae laashon mein kis ja
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhondhti hoon tumhein mere jaani
Ho kahan mere yusufe saani
Pyaas mein tum ne paya na paani
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Ab kahan se kaho tumko la-oon
Lori de de kise ab sulaoon
Kiske jhoole ki dori hilaoon
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Halq par teer-e-bedaad khaye
Khoon mein sar se paa tak nahaye
Qoob jungle mein aaram paaye
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Kook meri jala kar meri jaan
Hogaye raahe qaaliq pah qurban
Chey maheene rahe ma ke mehman
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanha sa sar sinha par chadha hae
Kunba sar nangay rotah khada hae
Jhula qaali tumhara pada hae
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
<<DIVIDER>>
Aao ae jaane maadar ab aao
Goad qaali hae aakar basao
Kahin jungle mein tum darr na jao
Aao Asghar tumhari bala loon
